meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体框架装好命令行网关,并恢复运行、审批与设置配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在给智能体框架接入新的网关组件,需要一次装好并恢复运行配置。
copy.tagline_en: Install a CLI gateway into your agent framework and restore runtime and approval setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're wiring a new gateway into your agent framework and need it installed and running.

howto.what: 把 OneCLI 的适配器、测试与 agent 指引复制到 NanoClaw 对应路径，注册该网关提供方，装好固定版本 SDK，再运行 setup 脚本配置网关。全部步骤成功后才写入 NANOCLAW_GATEWAY_PROVIDER=onecli，凭据不进入 agent 容器。
howto.when: 当安装设置选中 OneCLI、已有 OneCLI 安装要迁移到 gateway seam，或需从 in-tree 包恢复其运行时与审批桥等组件时触发。

say.text: 用 add-onecli 技能把 OneCLI 网关装好
say.note: 会复制适配器、装固定 SDK 并运行 setup 脚本。

say.text: 验证 OneCLI 网关的构建和测试能通过
say.note: 会跑 build 与列出的 vitest 用例。

say.text: 把已有的 OneCLI 安装迁移到 gateway seam
say.note: 健康安装会被复用，否则装本地网关。

howto.what_en: Copies OneCLI's adapter, tests, and agent guidance into NanoClaw paths, registers the provider, installs the pinned SDK, and runs the setup script. Only after all steps succeed does it write NANOCLAW_GATEWAY_PROVIDER=onecli; credentials stay out of agent containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

say_en.text: Use the add-onecli skill to install the OneCLI gateway
say_en.note: Copies adapters, installs the SDK, runs setup.

say_en.text: Validate the OneCLI gateway build and tests
say_en.note: Runs build and the listed vitest files.

say_en.text: Migrate my existing OneCLI install to the gateway seam
say_en.note: Reuses a healthy install, else installs locally.
